entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor Planeswalker called the Lithomancer who helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar and has kept watch over the prison for millennia; she wakes from her slumber when the Eldrazi stir.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A Planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi with Nahiri; he does not answer her summons, and she resolves to find him.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon who helped imprison the Eldrazi and forged the magic of the Eye of Ugin; he does not answer Nahiri's call.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, where the Eldrazi are imprisoned and which reacts painfully to their stirring.

entities.name: The Eye of Ugin
aliases: the chamber of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: The stone hall in Akoum where the great hedron stands, the nexus point of the hedron network, and where the three Planeswalkers can summon each other.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A region of Zendikar that shudders around the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A region of Zendikar where Nahiri finds a ruined kor city.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Creatures of the Blind Eternities imprisoned on Zendikar, whose lesser broods erupt from the ground when the prison is disturbed.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan; the kor depict a prophet in his likeness.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan; vampires on Zendikar worship a statue in his likeness.

entities.name: The kor
entities.description: Nahiri's people, whom she taught lithomancy and trained to guard the Eldrazi prison; they later remember the Eldrazi as gods.

entities.name: The vampires of Zendikar
entities.description: Hooked, red-painted vampire-like creatures who worship Ulamog and whose blood rituals disrupt the hedron network.

entities.name: The hedron network
entities.description: The network of hedrons that binds the Eldrazi titans' shadows to Zendikar.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, from which the Eldrazi come and through which Nahiri travels.

events.summary: The Eldrazi stir and Nahiri wakes from her long slumber, a thousand years before the great reawakening.
Flashback: Nahiri recalls living among the kor for centuries, teaching lithomancy and training them to guard the prison, before withdrawing in apathy to the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: She had trained the kor to keep watch over the Eldrazi prison

events.summary: Zendikar breaks open; Nahiri senses the Eldrazi prison has been opened.
events.quote: the prison of the Eldrazi. It was open.

events.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
events.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

events.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
events.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

events.summary: Nahiri crushes Eldrazi with an avalanche, then enters a ruined kor city in Ondu and remembers her old life.
events.quote: sent an avalanche to crush the abominations

events.summary: Nahiri finds a carving of herself with a Kozilek-like figure named 'Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib', and collapses the building, blaming herself for calling Kozilek a god.
Nahiri visits the hedron network's sites, burying the Eldrazi broods she finds, and determines she must stop them alone.
events.quote: But she was alone, and she would do it alone.

events.summary: Near the Eye of Ugin, Nahiri finds a spiked stone building where the hedron network was disturbed and is furious.
events.quote: Even as she approached, she could tell that this was the point where the hedron network had been disturbed.

events.summary: Nahiri fights and kills vampires at the building with a glowing-hot sword.
events.quote: her glowing sword cut through cold flesh

events.summary: Nahiri discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes the vampires' sacrifices disrupted the hedron network.
events.quote: their rites had successfully disrupted the hedron network enough for the Eldrazi broods to spill forth.

events.summary: Nahiri reshapes the statue into a new hedron, holding off more vampires and Eldrazi while she works alone.
events.quote: and brought the walls down on them, then returned to her work.

events.summary: Nahiri completes the hedron and repairs the Eldrazi prison, driving the titans back into torpor.
events.quote: to link up the broken lines of the hedron network and repair the Eldrazi prison.

events.summary: Nahiri, angry that Sorin abandoned her, decides to find him and wake him, and opens a pathway through the Blind Eternities to another plane.
events.quote: eager to find her oldest friend.

relations.note: Oldest friend; they imprisoned the Eldrazi together.
relations.quote: remind him of her and Zendikar and the friendship they had once shared

relations.note: Worked with the Spirit Dragon to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: The great spell that she, Sorin, and the Spirit Dragon had wrought was not a simple cage.

relations.note: Taught the kor lithomancy and how to guard the prison.
relations.quote: She had taught lithomancy to a long, long stream of students
The kor Planeswalker Nahiri, called the Lithomancer

relations.note: She kills those who disrupted the hedron network.
relations.quote: three dark figures came around the building from the other side, crouching into combat stances as they spotted her.

relations.note: The Eye of Ugin lies in the mountains of Akoum.
relations.quote: a site high in the mountains near the Eye of Ugin

relations.note: They worship Ulamog as a god.
relations.quote: Whether Ulamog heard the vampires' prayers or not
